title: [Seething Crescent, Rim]
description: The crescent-shaped rim overlooks an alien plaza centered around a luminous white crystal, the cyclopean construction possessed of strange geometries not meant for humanoid occupation.  Immense in scope and towering in height, the crystal sparks with occasional flashes of power from within.  A fringe of flowstones dangles from the ceiling of the overlook like descending talons, obscuring the view in places.
